thread.title: Equities Research Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for January, 3rd (AAPL, ARNC, ARRY, BBT, CBI, CERN, COF, CUBI, DKS, DXC)

author: Wayne Rhoads
title: Equities Research Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for January, 3rd (AAPL, ARNC, ARRY, BBT, CBI, CERN, COF, CUBI, DKS, DXC)
text:
Tweet 
Equities Research Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Wednesday, January 3rd: 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $162.00 price target by analysts at Barclays PLC. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts: 
Arconic (NYSE:ARNC) had its hold rating reissued by analysts at Cowen Inc. They currently have a $25.00 target price on the stock. 
Array BioPharma (NASDAQ:ARRY) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald. The firm currently has a $15.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “ARRY and ASLAN (NC) have updated a 2011 agreement for varlitinib, a pan-HER2 inhibitor, providing nearer term cash to ARRY in exchange for commercialization rights (the prior agreement covered development).”” 
BB&T (NYSE:BBT) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at Robert W. Baird. They currently have a $50.00 target price on the stock. 
Chicago Bridge & Iron (NYSE:CBI) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at Robert W. Baird. Robert W. Baird currently has a $17.00 price target on the stock. 
Cerner (NASDAQ:CERN) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Robert W. Baird. 
Capital One Financial (NYSE:COF) had its hold rating reaffirmed by analysts at Robert W. Baird. They currently have a $106.00 price target on the stock. 
Customers Bancorp (NYSE:CUBI) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at B. Riley. The firm currently has a $41.00 target price on the stock.

Genesco (NYSE:GCO) had its hold rating reaffirmed by analysts at Robert W. Baird. Robert W. Baird currently has a $35.00 price target on the stock. 
Godaddy (NYSE:GDDY) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at B. Riley. B. Riley currently has a $53.00 price target on the stock. 
Greenhill & Co., Inc. (NYSE:GHL) had its price target trimmed by Nomura from $14.00 to $13.00. Nomura currently has a reduce rating on the stock. 
Good Times Restaurants (NASDAQ:GTIM) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Maxim Group. The firm currently has a $6.00 price target on the stock. The analysts wrote, “We maintain our Buy rating and $6 price target on Good Times Restaurants (GTIM) following the release of preliminary F1Q18 (December) sales results early this morning.”” 
Huntington Bancshares (NASDAQ:HBAN) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at Robert W. Baird. Robert W. Baird currently has a $16.00 target price on the stock. 
Hibbett Sports (NASDAQ:HIBB) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at Robert W. Baird. Robert W. Baird currently has a $21.00 target price on the stock. 
Hilton Worldwide (NYSE:HLT) had its target price boosted by Argus from $2.40 to $94.00. They currently have a positive rating on the stock. 
InterDigital (NASDAQ:IDCC) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at B. Riley. They currently have a $100.00 price target on the stock. 
Ligand Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:LGND) had its average rating reaffirmed by analysts at HC Wainwright. HC Wainwright currently has a $169.00 price target on the stock. 
Lowe's Companies (NYSE:LOW) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Robert W. Baird. They currently have a $110.00 target price on the stock. 
McDonald's (NYSE:MCD) had its target price raised by SunTrust Banks, Inc. from $163.00 to $205.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock. 
MasTec (NYSE:MTZ) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Robert W. Baird. The firm currently has a $56.00 price target on the stock.

The analysts wrote, “This morning, Spark announced initial plans on U.S. pricing, including a wholesale acquisition cost for LUXTURNA of $425,000/eye ($850,000/ patient).””

Rocky Brands (NASDAQ:RCKY) had its hold rating reissued by analysts at Robert W. Baird. The firm currently has a $18.00 target price on the stock.

Spectrum Brands (NYSE:SPB) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Rowe. They currently have a $167.00 price target on the stock. The analysts wrote, “In a move we have encouraged since 2013, management announced strategic options for Global Batteries & Appliances (GB&A). The move will make SPB a faster organic grower and a higher-margin company. A potential deal—sometime in 2018—should provide significant financial flexibility to allow management to create meaningful shareholder value. It should also remove the AMZN battery overhang. We believe the deal could gross SPB $2.9-3.2B. SPB may be able to use HRG’s NOL to offset the tax hit, as Batteries has almost no cost basis and Appliances has a lower (but higher) one. Maintain Outperform.”” 
Sportsman's Warehouse (NASDAQ:SPWH) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Robert W. Baird. The firm currently has a $8.00 target price on the stock.

Energous (NASDAQ:WATT) had its price target boosted by Ladenburg Thalmann Financial Services from $20.00 to $32.00. Ladenburg Thalmann Financial Services currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
Wingstop (NASDAQ:WING) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Robert W. Baird. The firm currently has a $49.00 price target on the stock.   Apple Inc   Apple Inc
